@@ -0,0 +1,31 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8780'
+title: ThreadFloatingControlsHostedTests hangs after the scroll perf merge
+---
+After the merge of the scroll perf cards (main c4ac6dfa), the hosted suite ThreadFloatingControlsHostedTests hangs with no output, also with --no-parallel. In a parallel run, `theShowOfThePillKeepsTheBottomInsetOfTheList` started and did not end. The other hosted suites of the thread pass (bar frame 2/2, header menu 12/12, ConversationView 12/12). A hang with no output means that one synchronous layout call does not end.
+
+Suspect A (most likely, for the pill test): 4ea3642f `ProposalSizedLayout` (`Sources/AgentViewKit/Thread/ProposalSizedLayout.swift:18-20`) gives zero for an unspecified dimension. The ideal size of the thread content is then 0 by 0. The bar layout can measure the composer (an EditorKit text view that AppKit backs, `PromptInputHost`) at width 0 and then at the real width. Each measure can change the frame of the text view and mark the hosting view for layout again: a possible loop. `ThreadBarSizeQueryTests` mounts only a `Text` composer, so no unit test runs this path.
+
+Suspect B (for `aStreamedTurnKeepsTheThreadPinnedToTheBottom` and `aPressOnThePillOfTheThreadShowsAllOfTheLastRow`): e99fc24b keeps `.edge(.bottom)` in the scroll position (`ConversationLayout.scroll(_:to:)`, `Sources/AgentViewKit/Thread/ConversationView.swift:108-115`). ^66has33 measured that SwiftUI applies a kept edge again past the end of the content.
+
+## What
+- [ ] Write unit test A first in `Tests/AgentViewKitTests/Thread/ThreadBarSizeQueryTests.swift` (or a new file next to it): mount `AgentThreadView` with a `PromptInputView` composer (a real EditorKit text view) in a window that is never ordered in. Do one `layoutSubtreeIfNeeded()` and read `intrinsicContentSize` one time. Expect no size query at width 0 in the composer, and a height above 0. If the test hangs, that also shows the loop: stop it and record that.
+- [ ] Fix A: in `ProposalSizedLayout.sizeThatFits`, give the proposal when both dimensions are specified; for an unspecified dimension, ask the child. Keep `ThreadBarSizeQueryTests` green (no bar query on a scroll frame).
+- [ ] If test B (below) shows a loop, fix B: near the bottom, scroll by id to the last row with the anchor `.bottom`; keep `.edge(.bottom)` only for a scroll from far up.
+- [ ] Update the doc comments.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] Unit test A passes, and it fails (or hangs) at c4ac6dfa.
+- [ ] `swift test` passes with 0 failures and 0 code warnings.
+- [ ] One hosted run of `ThreadFloatingControlsHostedTests` with --no-parallel passes (this run needs the screen; the orchestrator does it).
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] Unit test A as above. Certain: a fixed count of synchronous layout calls, no clock, no wait.
+- [ ] Unit test B (optional, only if A does not show the hang): transcript of 31 entries, the tall slot, `anchors.onScroll(.bottom)`, then three passes of `needsLayout = true` and `layoutSubtreeIfNeeded()`; expect the same clip origin after each pass and a placed row.
+- [ ] `swift test` at the repo root.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #perf #bug
\ No newline at end of file
